Applied to a 64-byte payload blob at .data 0x140004000 (file offset 0x2800). Decryption order in code: XOR first (buf,len=0x40,key,keylen=0xA), then RC4 KSA/PRGA (keylen=0x10).
encryption_details.key: XOR key: DE AD BE EF 13 37 CA FE BA BE (10 bytes); RC4 key: "Hollowing_PE!!!!" (16 bytes)
encryption_details.key_storage: Both keys stored in cleartext in .rdata: XOR key @ 0x140005000, RC4 key @ 0x140005010, adjacent to plaintext ntdll API-name strings.

file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) console executable, MinGW-w64 GCC 13, stripped
